subject: english
title: A Prayer for Healing
instructions: Literature practice for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

sections.title: Identify the following sentences as True or False.

questions.q: The poem 'A Prayer For Healing' is about saving life on earth.
Earth is a home only for humans.
Healing of earth renews life.
The refrain of the poem is 'We join with the earth and with each other'.
The poet asks us to cut down forests to build more homes.
The poet wants us to promote justice and peace.

sections.title: Read the passage and fill in the blanks.

questions.q: We join with the earth and with each ________.
We bring new life to the ________.
We restore the waters and refresh the ________.

sections.passage:
We join with the earth and with each other
To bring new life to the land
To restore the waters
To refresh the air

sections.title: Read the passage and fill in the blanks.

questions.q: We join together to renew the ________.
We care for the ________.
We protect the ________.

sections.passage:
We join with the earth and with each other
To renew the forests
To care for the plants
To protect the creatures

questions.q: We must bring new life to the land by not polluting the ________.
We must not cut down ________.
We must work together for ________.
To recreate the human community, we must promote justice and ________.

sections.title: Answer in one or two sentences (about 30 words).

questions.q: What should humans do to make the world a better place to live in?
questions.answer: They should join with the earth and each other to clean the land, water and air, renew forests, protect plants and creatures, and promote justice and peace.

questions.q: What must we do if we want fresh air and water in the future?
questions.answer: We must stop polluting, restore the waters, refresh the air and renew the forests by working together to heal the earth.

questions.q: What does the poet want us to do to water, air and plants?
questions.answer: To restore the waters, refresh the air and care for the plants.

questions.q: What is the refrain in the poem and why is it used?
questions.answer: 'We join with the earth and with each other.' It is repeated at the start of every stanza to stress unity and collective effort and to give the poem the rhythm of a prayer.

questions.q: What does 'to remember our children' mean in the poem?
questions.answer: It means we must protect the earth for future generations so that our children inherit a healthy, peaceful world.

questions.q: What is the central idea of 'A Prayer for Healing'?
questions.answer: The earth is our only home and we have harmed it. The poem is an appeal to all people to join together with the earth and with each other to clean the land, water and air, renew forests, protect creatures, enjoy nature's gifts and promote justice and peace, so that the earth is healed and all life renewed for our children.

or.q: Why is the poem called a 'prayer'?
or.answer: Like a prayer it is said together by many people, with a repeated refrain and a humble, hopeful tone. It asks for the healing of the earth and the renewal of all life, and calls all people, as parts of 'one loving mystery', to work together.
